Klee, a director and Co-Chief Executive Officer, sold common stock in automatic transactions to cover tax withholding on vested performance stock units at weighted average sale prices of $32.1293 for one block and $33.1552 for a second block, generating total proceeds of $980,263, and following the transactions he directly beneficially owns 3,613,056 shares of common stock.

Joshua B. Cohen, an insider and Co-Chief Executive Officer, reported two automatic sales to cover tax withholding on vested performance stock units executed on 2026-09-10 at weighted average prices of $32.1557 and $33.1488 per share, generating total proceeds of $980,503, and following the reported transactions he directly owned 3,613,123 shares of common stock.
